answer: Ballot weight attaches only to exclusive custody of one oven-stabilized timing crystal whose hourly, lab-signed phase-noise traces are published on-chain. Mid-epoch an unaffiliated auditor launches a frequency hop along a reserved dark-fiber vine; the crystal must recapture the enrolled beat inside a short bound, and the leftover spectrum has to land in the same umber noise floor measured at intake. Identities that share an oven, or fake the beat with a software clock, miss that fingerprint and forfeit the retainer. Many votes then require many real crystals, not many keys.
